about: The load notices each sample may show when it opens (samples.spec.ts). An entry is the start of a notice. Remove an entry in the commit that closes its gap; add one only for a gap listed in docs/parity-checklist.md.

technical-report: Fields show the result Word last saved while editing
Formatting-change revisions retain their prior run-properties snapshots and support acceptance, rejection and Original display
Paragraph and character styles resolve supported formatting through basedOn chains and document defaults
Theme colors and fonts resolve for rendering through a separate layer
Numbering is resolved for decimal, Roman numeral, letter, ordinal, cardinal/ordinal text and bullet formats, including multilevel lvlText and legal numbering
Table grid widths, merges, borders, shading, cell alignment/margins and table style conditional formatting resolve for rendering
PAGE, NUMPAGES, SECTIONPAGES, DATE and TIME fields are recalculated in Print Layout
Merged, nested, or complex tables can be read, but their row and column structure cannot be edited safely
Comment ranges are modeled at run granularity
Inline pictures render from their original bytes and can be deleted or newly inserted
Floating pictures follow their text wrapping approximately
Chart content is rendered as a labeled placeholder and is not editable
